ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic arm
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement arm which is significantly more capable than the baseline limb and seamlessly integrates with the rest of the body. Adherents of the Machine Cult regard augmetics as True Flesh and will leave them unadorned, but people in the rest of the Imperium will often outfit their augmetics with synskin if they can afford it.

ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement eye which can see in significantly wider spectra and in greater detail than the baseline eye. While these augmetics can be made almost imperceptible in appearance from organic eyes, Mechanicus members prefer the augmetic to be obvious as a sign of devotion to the Machine God.

ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement heart. Significantly stronger than the baseline organ. Techpriests consider themselves above the irrational concerns of the laity, but the symbolic power of replacing the weak organic heart with True Flesh is not lost on even the least sentimental among them.

ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic lung
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement lung. Significantly stronger than the baseline organ. Breathing the sacred air of the Omnissiah is seen as an act of worship when done with a respiratory system formed of True Flesh.

ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic spine
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement spine. More resilient and efficient than the baseline body part. Replacing the failure-prone osseus spinal column with holy alloys and circuitry is something that many techpriests covet.

HediffDef.label: advanced augmetic spine
HediffDef.description: An installed augmetic replacement spine. More resilient and efficient than the baseline body part. Replacing the failure-prone osseus spinal column with holy alloys and circuitry is something that many techpriests covet.

RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement spine. More resilient and efficient than the baseline body part. Replacing the failure-prone osseus spinal column with holy alloys and circuitry is something that many techpriests covet.

ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic liver
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement liver which scrubs biotoxins from the hepatobiliary system. Significantly more efficient and resilient than the baseline organ. While techpriests sometimes prefer to do away entirely with unsavoury organic functions, others among them see it as a particularly devout act to use the Omnissiah's gifts to refine these functions as much as possible instead.

ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic kidney
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement kidney to filter toxins and waste from various bodily fluids. Significantly more efficient than the baseline organ. ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic jaw
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement jaw. Substantially more efficient than the baseline body part and seamlessly integrated with the rest of the cranium, it is able to modify its grip, bite, and chewing function at thought commands from the user. Many techpriests regard the ingestion of nutrients through the mouth to be inefficient, but perfecting the organic body with machine parts can be an act of worship in itself.

ThingDef.label: advanced vox receptor
ThingDef.description: An augmetic ear implant following advanced vox receptor schematics from the Dark Age of Technology. It can detect and process a far wider range of sounds than the baseline human ear, as well as radio and electromagnetic waves through which information can be passed.

HediffDef.label: advanced vox receptor
HediffDef.description: An installed augmetic ear implant following advanced vox receptor schematics from the Dark Age of Technology. It can detect and process a far wider range of sounds than the baseline human ear, as well as radio and electromagnetic waves through which information can be passed.

RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic ear implant following advanced vox receptor schematics from the Dark Age of Technology. It can detect and process a far wider range of sounds than the baseline human ear, as well as radio and electromagnetic waves through which information can be passed.

ThingDef.label: advanced augmetic stomach
ThingDef.description: An augmetic replacement stomach. Substantially more efficient than the baseline organ and seamlessly integrated with the rest of the digestive system, it is able to break down and process nutrients to a degree unknown in the natural world. Many techpriests regard the digestion of nutrients through the stomach to be inefficient, but perfecting the organic body with machine parts can be an act of worship in itself.

HediffDef.label: advanced augmetic stomach
HediffDef.description: An installed augmetic replacement stomach. Substantially more efficient than the baseline organ and seamlessly integrated with the rest of the digestive system, it is able to break down and process nutrients and neutralise potentially harmful materials. Many techpriests regard the digestion of nutrients through the stomach to be inefficient or even distasteful, but perfecting the organic body with machine parts can be an act of worship in itself.

RecipeDef.label: install advanced augmetic stomach
RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement stomach. Substantially more efficient than the baseline organ and seamlessly integrated with the rest of the digestive system, it is able to break down and process nutrients and neutralise potentially harmful materials. ThingDef.label: thermoregulation matrix
ThingDef.description: An implant uses a mixture of sanctified biochemical treatment and the deployment of microscopic automata in the cardiovascular system to reduce the impact of extreme temperatures on the baseline human body.

HediffDef.label: thermoregulation matrix
HediffDef.description: An installed implant uses a mixture of sanctified biochemical treatment and the deployment of microscopic automata in the cardiovascular system to reduce the impact of extreme temperatures on the baseline human body.

RecipeDef.label: install thermoregulation matrix
RecipeDef.description: Install an implant uses a mixture of sanctified biochemical treatment and the deployment of microscopic automata in the cardiovascular system to reduce the impact of extreme temperatures on the baseline human body.

ThingDef.label: Calculus Logi implant
ThingDef.description: A Calculus Logi implant. Miniaturised cogitators are implanted within the cranium and circulate a liquid data medium through the vessels and folds of the brain, speeding up the bearer's very thought processes. This implant is greatly coveted by scholars, scribes, and archivists of the Mechanicus, in spite of its tendency to induce fatigue in its users.

ThingDef.label: autosanguine
ThingDef.description: The autosanguine injects millions of microscopic automata into the cardiovascular system, tasking them with aiding the body's natural healing processes and repair of damaged tissues. While most adherents of the Machine Cult prefer to replace the organic tissues with holy machinery if possible, some see the value of boosting the capabilities of the flesh without replacing it entirely.
